events.info: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now. For groups of 10 or more please contact: info@grouptixs.com or 813-417-3481. Will Call is available in the West Lobby of the Coliseum only.
events.pleaseNote: A warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game. By purchasing this ticket, you give permission to use your likeness. Ultimate Fan Pass begins at 1:30 pm. Event doors and Tip-Off Party begin at 2:00 pm. Show begins at 3:00 pm. Bags (max size 8.5" x 11") are allowed and will be searched upon entry. Exceptions will be made for necessary medical equipment and bags for nursing mothers. CASHLESS - the Alliant Energy Center services all credit and debit payments only. No cash accepted. Facility Fee and Parking included within price of ticket. All guests two and older must have a ticket to enter arena. By purchasing tickets to this event you agree to abide by entry requirements in effect at the time of the event. Check the [venue website](https://www.alliantenergycenter.com/) leading up to your event for the latest protocols.

events.info: Joey's Song Freezing Man 80's Night: Like, Totally Cool On January 8th, Rock n Roll Hall of Famers and Grammy Winners are coming together at The Sylvee in Madison, WI to play the some of the greatest music of the 1980's in a one of a kind, never before seen concert experience. The songs you grew up loving, performed live by some of the most celebrated artists in the world. Expect the hits, expect the surprises, and expect to know every single word. The Joey's Song Freezing Man Concerts is a 100% volunteer organization so every penny we net goes to finding treatments and cures for Epilepsy. Join us for the ONLY major music festival in the world that fights epilepsy. And it's right here in Madison! Joey's Song was established in memory of Joey Gomoll who died just shy of his fifth birthday after battling epilepsy his entire life.
events.pleaseNote: Doors at 5:30 pm | Show at 7:00 pm. CASHLESS VENUE - The Sylvee services all credit and debit payments only. No cash accepted. Bags (max size 12" x 6" x 12") are allowed and will be searched upon entry. Exceptions will be made for necessary medical equipment and bags for nursing mothers. We encourage you to pack light with only the necessities to make the entry process as smooth as possible. Tickets can be purchased online up to the event start time. Once the event has started, if tickets are still available, they can be purchased at the Sylvee box office.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Box Office hours are Wednesday, Friday and Saturday from 10AM to 3PM and on all event days from 2 hours prior to showtime until the headlining act goes on stage.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Box Office accepts MasterCard, Visa, Discover, and American Express payments. The venue is a cashless facility and will NOT accept cash or checks.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Available on the day of the show. Customer must have actual credit card, picture ID and order number.

venues.parkingDetail: South Livingston Street Garage - across the street. 111 S Livingston St, Madison, WI 53703 $8-$10 event parking. There is also plenty of free street parking in the area surrounding The Sylvee. Some street parking has an unmetered 2 hour limit so pay attention to signs.
